program.name: Southpaw Switch
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Boxing bouts that switch stance each bout, so both hands learn to lead.
program.about: Boxing bouts that switch stance every bout, so both sides learn to lead and to throw the power hand. The odd bouts are orthodox, left foot forward, and the even bouts southpaw, the mirror image; the voice calls the stance with each combo. The combinations stay the same, which makes the weak side easy to hear and to feel. Levels II and III bring longer combinations, and abs finish every session.
